description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'DefinitionIdentifierInvalidException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception indicates an invalid structure of a feature definition identifier, providing constructors, a builder pattern, and static factory methods for creating instances based on message or JSON input.
